name: fusion-v1
description: Search-time stages of the recommended system (Anticipate-0.6B + passages + CPC strict + BM25). Weights were tuned on dev half A (md5(query_id) even) and reported on dev half B; the test half was scored once with these values.

passages.comment: family score = max(document score, best description-chunk score); a family missing from one list counts as missing_score there

cpc_strict.comment: fused = z(score) + weight * level / 3 over the query's list; z = per-query z-score (population SD, +1e-9); level = best agreement between the CPC printed on the query document and the current CPC of the candidate family's members published before the query's priority date

bm25.comment: fused = z(previous stage) + weight * z(BM25) over the union of both lists; a family missing from a list gets that list's minimum z
